label: Fleet config
info:
Fleet-wide settings used by the CI/CD flow.

TB_USERNAME / TB_PASSWORD: ThingsBoard tenant admin login.
Change them in this flow (fleet-config.json in GitHub), never in the CI/CD flow.
Rotation order: create the new login first, update this file, wait 24 h, then remove the old login.

name: ThingsBoard login for the CI/CD flow is in this tab's env (TB_USERNAME, TB_PASSWORD)
